effects.effect: You and each ally within 5 squares of you ignore negative effects from inclement weather, such as [banes](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/bane) or environmental damage. Additionally, you can use the Blessing of Fortunate Weather feature as if you were a 1st-level [conduit](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/class/conduit) (see 1st-Level Domain Feature in the [Conduit](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/class/conduit) section).
